audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for persecution warning, Paraclete/Spirit of truth, conviction, guiding into truth, grief-to-joy birth imagery, asking in name, plain speech, peace/tribulation.

verses.restored: These things I have spoken to you so that you may not be made to stumble.

familiar.text: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.

modern.text: “I have told you these things so that you will not fall away.

original.text: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ σκανδαλισθῆτε.

verses.restored: They will put you out of synagogues; indeed an hour is coming when everyone who kills you will think to offer service to the Divine.

familiar.text: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

modern.text: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.

original.text: ἀποσυναγώγους ποιήσουσιν ὑμᾶς· ἀλλʼ ἔρχεται ὥρα ἵνα πᾶς ὁ ἀποκτείνας ὑμᾶς δόξῃ λατρείαν προσφέρειν τῷ θεῷ.

verses.restored: They will do these things because they did not know the Father nor me.

familiar.text: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

modern.text: They will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me.

original.text: καὶ ταῦτα ποιήσουσιν ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὸν πατέρα οὐδὲ ἐμέ.

verses.restored: But I have spoken these things to you so that when their hour comes, you may remember that I told you. I did not say these things to you from the beginning because I was with you.

familiar.text: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

modern.text: But I have told you these things so that when their hour comes, you will remember that I told you about them. I did not tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you. The Promise of the Holy Spirit (John 14:15–26)

original.text: ἀλλὰ ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἡ ὥρα ⸀αὐτῶν μνημονεύητε ⸁αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν. Ταῦτα δὲ ὑμῖν ἐξ ἀρχῆς οὐκ εἶπον, ὅτι μεθʼ ὑμῶν ἤμην.

verses.restored: Now I go to the One who sent me, and none of you asks me, Where are you going?

familiar.text: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

modern.text: Now, however, I am going to Him who sent Me; yet none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’

original.text: νῦν δὲ ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πέμψαντά με καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐρωτᾷ με· Ποῦ ὑπάγεις;

verses.restored: But because I have spoken these things to you, grief has filled your heart.

familiar.text: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

modern.text: Instead, your hearts are filled with sorrow because I have told you these things.

original.text: ἀλλʼ ὅτι ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἡ λύπη πεπλήρωκεν ὑμῶν τὴν καρδίαν.

verses.restored: But I tell you the truth: it is advantageous for you that I go away. For if I do not go away, the Advocate/Paraclete will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.

familiar.text: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

modern.text: But I tell you the truth, it is for your benefit that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.

original.text: ἀλλʼ ἐγὼ τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγω ὑμῖν, συμφέρει ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐγὼ ἀπέλθω. ἐὰν ⸀γὰρ μὴ ἀπέλθω, ὁ παράκλητος ⸂οὐ μὴ ἔλθῃ⸃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς· ἐὰν δὲ πορευθῶ, πέμψω αὐτὸν πρὸς ὑμᾶς.

verses.restored: When that one comes, he will expose/convict the world concerning sin/misalignment, concerning righteousness/justice, and concerning judgment.

familiar.text: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

modern.text: And when He comes, He will convict the world in regard to sin and righteousness and judgment:

original.text: καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐκεῖνος ἐλέγξει τὸν κόσμον περὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ περὶ δικαιοσύνης καὶ περὶ κρίσεως·

verses.restored: Concerning sin/misalignment, because they do not trust into me.

familiar.text: Of sin, because they believe not on me;

modern.text: in regard to sin, because they do not believe in Me;

original.text: περὶ ἁμαρτίας μέν, ὅτι οὐ πιστεύουσιν εἰς ἐμέ·

verses.restored: Concerning righteousness/justice, because I go to the Father and you behold me no longer.

familiar.text: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;

modern.text: in regard to righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you will no longer see Me;

original.text: περὶ δικαιοσύνης δέ, ὅτι πρὸς τὸν ⸀πατέρα ὑπάγω καὶ οὐκέτι θεωρεῖτέ με·

verses.restored: Concerning judgment, because the ruler of this world has been judged.

familiar.text: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

modern.text: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world has been condemned.

original.text: περὶ δὲ κρίσεως, ὅτι ὁ ἄρχων τοῦ κόσμου τούτου κέκριται.

verses.restored: I still have many things to say to you, but you are not able to bear them now.

familiar.text: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

modern.text: I still have much to tell you, but you cannot yet bear to hear it.

original.text: Ἔτι πολλὰ ἔχω ⸂ὑμῖν λέγειν⸃, ἀλλʼ οὐ δύνασθε βαστάζειν ἄρτι·

verses.restored: But when that one comes, the Spirit of truth, he will guide you into all truth; for he will not speak from himself, but whatever he hears he will speak, and the coming things he will announce to you.

familiar.text: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

modern.text: However, when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth. For He will not speak on His own, but He will speak what He hears, and He will declare to you what is to come.

original.text: ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ ἐκεῖνος, τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας, ὁδηγήσει ὑμᾶς ⸂ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ πάσῃ⸃, οὐ γὰρ λαλήσει ἀφʼ ἑαυτοῦ, ἀλλʼ ὅσα ⸀ἀκούσει λαλήσει, καὶ τὰ ἐρχόμενα ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.

verses.restored: That one will glorify me, because he will receive from what is mine and announce it to you.

familiar.text: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

modern.text: He will glorify Me by taking from what is Mine and disclosing it to you.

original.text: ἐκεῖνος ἐμὲ δοξάσει, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λήμψεται καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.

verses.restored: All things that the Father has are mine; because of this I said that he receives from what is mine and announces it to you.

familiar.text: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

modern.text: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you.

original.text: πάντα ὅσα ἔχει ὁ πατὴρ ἐμά ἐστιν· διὰ τοῦτο εἶπον ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λαμβάνει καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.

verses.restored: A little while, and you behold me no longer; and again a little while, and you will see me.

familiar.text: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.

modern.text: In a little while you will see Me no more, and then after a little while you will see Me. ” Grief Will Turn to Joy

original.text: Μικρὸν καὶ ⸀οὐκέτι θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ ⸀με.

verses.restored: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, What is this he says to us, A little while and you do not behold me, and again a little while and you will see me, and, Because I go to the Father?

familiar.text: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

modern.text: Then some of His disciples asked one another, “Why is He telling us, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”

original.text: εἶπαν οὖν ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ πρὸς ἀλλήλους· Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο ὃ λέγει ἡμῖν· Μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με; καί· ⸀Ὅτι ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πατέρα;

verses.restored: They were saying, What is this little while? We do not know what he speaks.

familiar.text: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.

modern.text: They kept asking, “Why is He saying, ‘a little while’? We do not understand what He is saying.”

original.text: ἔλεγον οὖν· ⸂Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο⸃ ὃ ⸀λέγει μικρόν; οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί λαλεῖ.

verses.restored: Jesus knew they wanted to ask him, and said to them, Are you seeking with one another about this, that I said, A little while and you do not behold me, and again a little while and you will see me?

familiar.text: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

modern.text: Aware that they wanted to question Him, Jesus said to them, “Are you asking one another why I said, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’?

original.text: ⸀ἔγνω Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἤθελον αὐτὸν ἐρωτᾶν, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Περὶ τούτου ζητεῖτε μετʼ ἀλλήλων ὅτι εἶπον· Μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με;

verses.restored: Amen, amen, I say to you: you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice; you will be grieved, but your grief will become joy.

familiar.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

modern.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.

original.text: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι κλαύσετε καὶ θρηνήσετε ὑμεῖς, ὁ δὲ κόσμος χαρήσεται· ⸀ὑμεῖς λυπηθήσεσθε, ἀλλʼ ἡ λύπη ὑμῶν εἰς χαρὰν γενήσεται.

verses.restored: A woman, when she gives birth, has grief because her hour has come; but when the child is born, she no longer remembers the pressure because of joy that a human has been born into the world.

familiar.text: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

modern.text: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come; but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.

original.text: ἡ γυνὴ ὅταν τίκτῃ λύπην ἔχει, ὅτι ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα αὐτῆς· ὅταν δὲ γεννήσῃ τὸ παιδίον, οὐκέτι μνημονεύει τῆς θλίψεως διὰ τὴν χαρὰν ὅτι ἐγεννήθη ἄνθρωπος εἰς τὸν κόσμον.

verses.restored: So you also now have grief; but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one takes your joy from you.

familiar.text: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

modern.text: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy. Ask in My Name (Matthew 18:19–20)

original.text: καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν ⸂νῦν μὲν λύπην⸃ ἔχετε· πάλιν δὲ ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς, καὶ χαρήσεται ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία, καὶ τὴν χαρὰν ὑμῶν οὐδεὶς ⸀αἴρει ἀφʼ ὑμῶν.

verses.restored: In that day you will ask me nothing. Amen, amen, I say to you: whatever you ask the Father in my name, he will give you.

familiar.text: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

modern.text: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.

original.text: καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐμὲ οὐκ ἐρωτήσετε οὐδέν· ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ⸂ἄν τι⸃ αἰτήσητε τὸν πατέρα ⸂δώσει ὑμῖν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου⸃.

verses.restored: Until now you have asked nothing in my name; ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be fulfilled.

familiar.text: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

modern.text: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.

original.text: ἕως ἄρτι οὐκ ᾐτήσατε οὐδὲν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου· αἰτεῖτε καὶ λήμψεσθε, ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ὑμῶν ᾖ πεπληρωμένη.

verses.restored: These things I have spoken to you in figures; an hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you in figures, but will announce to you plainly concerning the Father.

familiar.text: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

modern.text: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you this way, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

original.text: Ταῦτα ἐν παροιμίαις λελάληκα ὑμῖν· ⸀ἔρχεται ὥρα ὅτε οὐκέτι ἐν παροιμίαις λαλήσω ὑμῖν ἀλλὰ παρρησίᾳ περὶ τοῦ πατρὸς ⸀ἀπαγγελῶ ὑμῖν.

verses.restored: In that day you will ask in my name, and I do not say to you that I will ask the Father concerning you,

familiar.text: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:

modern.text: In that day you will ask in My name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.

original.text: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου αἰτήσεσθε, καὶ οὐ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν πατέρα περὶ ὑμῶν·

verses.restored: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me and have trusted that I came from the Divine.

familiar.text: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

modern.text: For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.

original.text: αὐτὸς γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ φιλεῖ ὑμᾶς, ὅτι ὑμεῖς ἐμὲ πεφιλήκατε καὶ πεπιστεύκατε ὅτι ἐγὼ παρὰ τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ ἐξῆλθον.

verses.restored: I came out from the Father and have come into the world; again I leave the world and go to the Father.

familiar.text: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

modern.text: I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.”

original.text: ἐξῆλθον ⸀ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ ἐλήλυθα εἰς τὸν κόσμον· πάλιν ἀφίημι τὸν κόσμον καὶ πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα.

verses.restored: His disciples say, Look, now you speak plainly and speak no figure.

familiar.text: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.

modern.text: His disciples said, “See, now You are speaking plainly and without figures of speech.

original.text: ⸀Λέγουσιν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ· Ἴδε νῦν ⸀ἐν παρρησίᾳ λαλεῖς, καὶ παροιμίαν οὐδεμίαν λέγεις.

verses.restored: Now we know that you know all things and have no need that anyone question you; by this we trust that you came from the Divine.

familiar.text: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

modern.text: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.”

original.text: νῦν οἴδαμεν ὅτι οἶδας πάντα καὶ οὐ χρείαν ἔχεις ἵνα τίς σε ἐρωτᾷ· ἐν τούτῳ πιστεύομεν ὅτι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθες.

verses.restored: Jesus answered them, Do you now trust?

familiar.text: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

modern.text: “Do you finally believe?” Jesus replied.

original.text: ἀπεκρίθη ⸀αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς· Ἄρτι πιστεύετε;

verses.restored: Look, an hour is coming, and has come, that you will be scattered, each to one's own, and you will leave me alone; yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

familiar.text: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

modern.text: “Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.

original.text: ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται ὥρα ⸀καὶ ἐλήλυθεν ἵνα σκορπισθῆτε ἕκαστος εἰς τὰ ἴδια κἀμὲ μόνον ἀφῆτε· καὶ οὐκ εἰμὶ μόνος, ὅτι ὁ πατὴρ μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν.

verses.restored: These things I have spoken to you so that in me you may have peace. In the world you have pressure/tribulation; but take courage: I have overcome the world.

familiar.text: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

modern.text: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”

original.text: ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐν ἐμοὶ εἰρήνην ἔχητε· ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ θλῖψιν ἔχετε, ἀλλὰ θαρσεῖτε, ἐγὼ νενίκηκα τὸν κόσμον.
